checks.name: Signed-out landing has one entry action and no staff sections
Keyboard Tab reaches named sign-in action
Keyboard Enter opens the sign-in screen
Keyboard traversal reaches phone, password, submit and help controls
Empty sign-in stays local and shows both field errors
Create-account mode is reachable without submitting
Switching back recovers from local validation state
Password visibility toggle updates its accessible action

detail.snapshot:
- heading "Sign in" [level=2]
- group:
  - radiogroup "Sign in or create an account":
    - radio "Sign in" [checked]
    - radio "Create account"
  - text: Your phone number is your sign-in username. We never send codes by SMS, and using a number here does not verify that you own it.
  - button "Country code Zambia (+260)": Used when you type a local number. Numbers starting with + work for any country.
  - textbox "Phone number (your username)"
  - text: For example +260 …, or a local number.
  - textbox "Password"
  - button "Hide password"
  - button "Sign in"
  - button "Forgot password?"
  - button "Get church help"

checks.name: Church-help action explains the real recovery route
Forgot-password entry and return are reachable without sending email
Back to sign in returns to empty credential fields
Reload restores the signed-out sign-in route
Narrow sign-in fields fit without page-level horizontal overflow
Narrow layout scrolls to church help
No auth or mutation request attempted
